_comment: Wifi Device, Wifi command and Wifi Event names (CR-X4-1). Read by tests/test_hub_operations.py (the backend refuses what 'ok' says is refused) and tests/frontend/wifi-names.test.ts (the card's sanitizer keeps an accepted name unchanged and changes a refused one). X1 hubs take ASCII letters, digits and spaces; X1S and X2 take letters, digits and combining marks in any script plus ASCII punctuation.
